facts.fact: This free public garden on Rua Dr.Justino Cruz was laid out in the twentieth century around a seventeenth-century fountain topped by Saint Barbara. The fountain was previously associated with the Convento dos Remédios.
The high crenellated wall behind the garden is a late-medieval facade belonging to Braga’s episcopal palace, not a separate castle. Flowering appearance is not guaranteed year-round.

notes: Garden setting, fountain and palace facade read; do not infer access inside the palace from viewing its wall.
